question: On the consumed fresh SceneNN cohort, can one preselected temporal midpoint turn the direct RoMa edge into a two-edge correspondence bridge and recover true-pair support without relaxing any matcher or NONE threshold?

mechanical_amendment.reason: The first replay attempt stopped before model construction because two crop-helper calls referenced the immediate module instead of its frozen predecessor; only those two namespace paths and this implementation hash changed.

predecessor.failure_signature: Direct endpoint RoMa support transferred on TF01 and TF04 but failed the low-purity TF02 and edge-clipped TF03 true pairs.
predecessor.single_change: Insert exactly one preselected midpoint frame and require unchanged absolute RoMa support on reference-to-midpoint and midpoint-to-query; keep crops, matcher weights, resolutions, support thresholds, reciprocal assignment, scenarios, targets and gate otherwise unchanged.

literature_basis.title: Predictive Cycle Consistency Learning for Human Motion Tracking
literature_basis.used_for: Treating temporal cycles as a stronger consistency signal than one direct long edge.

literature_basis.title: LocoTrack: Exploring Longer Contexts for Better Motion Tracking
literature_basis.used_for: Testing whether an explicit intermediate observation bridges difficult appearance and viewpoint change.

midpoint_selector.rule: Arithmetic midpoint of the frozen reference and query trajectory frames, rounded down to the nearest frozen trajectory stride of five; require a present pose and a non-empty provider target-mesh visibility mask before any midpoint RGB is opened.
midpoint_selector.tie_rule: For half-stride midpoints choose the earlier stride-aligned frame.

renderer.near_plane_face_rule: reject unless every vertex is beyond near plane
renderer.visibility_rule: target depth finite and no farther than full-scene depth plus 0.005 m

crop.source: Provider target-mesh truth-visible tight box independently at reference, midpoint and query.

matcher.absolute_support: Unchanged bilateral one-percent cycle fraction and majority cycle purity on each of both bridge edges.
matcher.rank_score: Geometric mean of unchanged reference-to-midpoint and midpoint-to-query symmetric cycle scores.
matcher.zero_assignment: Unchanged strict reciprocal maximum among pairs supported on both bridge edges.

baseline.model: Unchanged local DINOv2-S; bridge score is the geometric mean of reference-to-midpoint and midpoint-to-query cosine similarity.

forbidden_after_freeze: change midpoint frames, crop expansion, matcher, threshold, assignment, scenarios or gate
inspect or replace a midpoint after seeing RGB, DINOv2, RoMa or scenario results
claim freshness or confirmation authority from this consumed posthoc replay
drop TF02, TF03, any different-target pair, or any failed scenario
claim_boundary: This is consumed posthoc Development evidence for privileged truth-cropped three-frame temporal correspondence only. It does not prove raw-phone target detection, named entrance, venue ownership, access, traversability, approach waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, or safety.
